data.name: Jocelyn
data.gender_notes: Jocelyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jocelyn is derived from the Old French name 'Iocelinus', which means 'little, youthful, joyful'. It may also have a Celtic origin from the name 'Ioselin', which means 'God is gracious'. In Christian tradition, the name Jocelyn is associated with the Biblical figure of Joachim, the father of St. Anne, who was reinstated in God's grace after being barren for many years. Jocelyn is a beautiful and joyful name for a baby girl.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the joy and grace found in God's love and redemption.
data.etymology: Jocelyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Youthful, and Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jocelyn total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: יוסלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוסלין היא מקור גאלי-נורמני שמשמעותו יהלום. בסלאבי, iaselina ויוסלנה הם שמות מקור של האימפריה הביזנטית. ישנם שמות יהודיים (יוסל) מאותה העת. שמות רבים הם צאצא של הנורדים שכבשו את האימפריה הביזנטית. דברי ק. מלטש, עד, 1976

in_greek.name: Ιωσελίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Iozeleini είναι ένα Γαλλικό-Νορμανδικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ιωάνθινη. Η Iaselina και Yousalena ήταν ονοματεπίθετα από τη βυζαντινή αυτοκρατορία. Υπάρχουν επίσης Ιουδαϊκά ονόματα (Yousl) από την ίδια χρονιά. Πολλά ονόματα είναι θυγατρικά από τους Νορμανδούς που κατέκτησαν τη βυζαντινή αυτοκρατορία. Βλέπε K. Malltsh, Ed, 1976.

in_latin.name: Jocelyn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Iocelyn significat Iohelina, ex radicibus Galla Normannorum. In lingua Sclavica, Iaselina et Iuselana fuerunt nomina originales Imperii Byzantini. Etiam nomina Iudaica (Iusel) aetate eadem sunt. Multi nomina sunt originati a Normannis qui Imperium Byzantinum cepissent. Vide K. Malltsh, Ed, 1976.

in_english.name: Jocelyn
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jocelyn is a French Norman name meaning jewel. Derived from the Old French name Joscelyn, which is thought to be derived from the name of a Norman lord, Yssel. In Slavic languages, Yousalina and Youselena were original names of the Byzantine Empire. There are also Jewish names (Yousl) from the same era. Many names are offspring of the Normans who conquered the Byzantine Empire. See K. Malltsh, Ed, 1976.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Jocelyn: God's generous one. A name derived from the Old French 'Jocel' meaning 'Jesus' and 'lin' meaning 'generous'. It symbolizes the spiritual gift of generosity, inspired by the love and compassion of Christ.

historical_references.reference: Jocelyn of Flanders, also known as Joceline or Josceline, was the younger sister of Count Baldwin II of Hainaut. She married Ranulph II, Count of Boulogne, in 1119. Their son, Hugh, became Count of Boulogne in 1127. Jocelyn is mentioned in the 'Gesta Normannorum Ducum' (Deeds of the Normans), which recounts the history of the Duchy of Normandy from 911 to 1135.
historical_references.context: Marriage of Jocelyn of Flanders to Ranulph II, Count of Boulogne, and their son, Hugh.

historical_references.reference: Jocelyn of Brittany, also known as Josceline de Trevisa, was a 13th-century Breton noblewoman who became a Cistercian nun at the Abbey of Tintagel. She was known for her mystical experiences and visions, which were recorded in the 'Vita Sanctae Joscelinae' (Life of Saint Joscelin).
historical_references.context: Mystical experiences and visions of Jocelyn of Brittany, recorded in the 'Vita Sanctae Joscelinae'.
